title: note v0.8 and SVG rows: the verified mapping (input data for scripts/audit_note_N1.py --note-rows, profile v0_8; N1 round 11)
how_built: Chain K1's text comes first (its mapper's, round 1, and its checker's, round 2; it describes chain K1's 81 rows on note lines 1-60 only, and its sentence on ruling fields is restated by one of Code's edits before the ledger commit, 10e), then the merged file's, which Code wrote before the ledger commit and restated after its read of this round's first ledger run (10e). Chain K1's text: N1 round 11, chain K1, mapper round 1 (2026-10-29). Note v0.8 (RESEARCH-NOTE-v0_8-draft.md, sha256 6fcfbfd64784412d616d4de40d4a6a54596202a052cb3dd0d9d78a26cbe1198d, re-hashed: match) lines 1-60: spans S1 (1-24) and S2 (25-60). One row per matcher unit on those lines (81, from the round-11 inventory, coverage key and occurrence), no rows beyond the matcher (span notes). Each figure's claim is the note's in v0.8's words (clause); every cited line was read at its revision (git show). Restated rows start from the v0.6 row they restate (results/raw/2026-10-12_note-N1-v0_6-note-rows.json@c18854f): the same span keeps the v0.6 key, another span's restatement takes a new key from 1000; v0_6_row names the predecessor and round11 lists, mechanically, every field that differs from it (previous the v0.6 value, null if absent), the round's own n1v8_chain, v0_6_row and round11 excepted; a same-key row keeps the v0.6 row's history fields, a new-key row does not (they are listed as changed). Ruling fields (R1's corrected_in_note, scope_corrected_in_note, discharged, admitted_citation) were not set by the chains: the v0_8 ruling tables were empty at the chains' runs, the re-keys waiting on 4f's process (the release-block answers, results/raw/2026-10-28_note-design-to-code_release-block-answers.md@908a659:56), and the rows a ruling or a correction would reach were listed for the seat (the integration sets them; below). Built by a scratch script (build_rows.py) and self-checked with --dev-report (profile v0_8). Round 2 (K1 check, 2026-10-29), independent of the mapper: every row re-verified (coverage against the inventory's coverage keys; kind; clause against v0.8's line; every cited line read at its revision with git show; status by the contract's rules; v0_6_row and round11 recomputed mechanically against the v0.6 rows file @c18854f; the not-found row re-searched) and the self-check re-run. Two rows changed, each with n1v8_round2 recording the round-1 values: S1#1012 (the not-found search record extended) and S1#1013 (the as-built record carrier added as primary; source_value and comment). No kind, status, maps_to, ledger_row or key changed. Built by a scratch script (r2work/build_r2.py) from rows_r1.json (sha256 f315b1d8d4e392ef7384f0dec6603da72f05cac3c70bfc786b20ebc46e6b5fc3). The merged file (N1 round 11's integration, Code): 1128 rows, 695 figures and 433 not-figures, on note v0.8 and the three 2026-10-22 renders, from the twelve chains K1-K12, one provenance entry each. Each chain's set was mapped at round 1 and checked adversarially at round 2 by a checker that revised it (117 rows carry an n1v8_round2 record of their round-1 values), and the twelve sets were merged (sha256 ce71f7a6…ee1b; Code's round-11 list, results/raw/2026-10-29_note-code-to-design_N1-r11-rulings.md@d5123bf:3); 25 rows are beyond the matcher (9a's coverage table). A v0.6 row's same-span successor keeps its key (607 rows); every other row takes a new key from 1000 in its span (chain K5's from S5#2000, K9's from S8#2000, K10's from S8#3000; 521 rows); 703 rows name the v0.6 row they restate (v0_6_row). The integration's edits, as 10e lists them: E1 placed sixteen chain span notes, recorded in no row's round11 record and in no annotation; E2-E9 and E11 edited rows, each change in the row's round11 record under the finding 'round-11 integration (Code)'; E10 added fourteen span-note annotations, marked 'N1 round 11 (integration, Code)'. The integration's edit E9 restored, verbatim, the re-keys 4f gives Code (R1's corrected_in_note on S10#108 and S10#60; ruling 8's admitted_citation on S7#19 and S7#20) and ruling 13's scope_corrected_in_note on S11#18 and S11#19, as Code's round-11 list records (results/raw/2026-10-29_note-code-to-design_N1-r11-rulings.md@d5123bf:14, :44-46); the design seat confirmed ruling 13's (answer 1b item 1, results/raw/2026-11-02_note-design-to-code_N1-r11-answers.md@da50cd1:9). The integration's edit E12 applied the design seat's answers of 2026-11-02, routed by the PI (that file, its section 0): it set ruling fields on 24 rows (ruling 6 on the ten note rows of branch TS, chain K1's S1#134 and S1#214-S1#216 among them; R1 on S5#81 and S5#88; ruling 7 on S8#3074 and S8#3075; ruling 8 on S7#25 and S7#28; ruling 14 on S8#3143; ruling 15 on seven curve readings, chain K1's S1#1012 among them) and remapped 28 (answers 2a (i)-(ii) and 2b: S8#2057 and S8#2058 on the design seat's v1 raw (results/raw/2026-11-02_note-N1-r11_macar-v1-lines.md@da50cd1); S5#2048 and S8#2020 on Code's v5 raw (results/raw/2026-11-02_note-N1-r11_macar-v5-lines.md@633b6fd); the 24 computations on Code's computation raw (results/raw/2026-11-02_note-N1-r11_computations.md@e6d3197)), each change in its row's round11 record. The integration's text edits are recorded too: each row comment it restated, in the row's round11 record, and each in-place span-note edit, in that span note's annotations. The span-note annotations marked 'N1 round 11 (integration, Code; the design seat's answers of 2026-11-02)' are E12's and those of Code's edits before the ledger commit; those edits, among them the ones after Code's read of this round's first ledger run, are recorded as the integration's are, each row edit in the row's round11 record. After that read, Code also corrected chain K10's range to note lines 238-258 in the S8 header and in K10's provenance entry, which gave 238-259 (the S8 note 3 annotation records the header's), restated the twelve provenance entries' round and integration note, and restated the schema's round-11 entry, which named chain K1 alone (10e).

schema.row_fields: span, seq; then the mapper's fields: note_file, note_line (S9/S10: the text-node index under the matcher's extraction, which joins text/tspan/title/desc content one node per line), text (S9 writes "'<unit>' in node '<node text>'"), kind (figure | not-figure), maps_to (ledger-row | item-raw | audit-raw-new | record | none), status (reproduced | log-only | not found | discrepant | computed-new | not run | n/a), ledger_row, locator, source_value, clause, cause, comment, not_figure_reason; validation_note (N1 final's, where present); round 5: correction ({kind: wording|precision|scope, text, whose, basis}), corrected_in_note ({locator, quote}), status_basis ({locator, quote}), validation_exempts (checks a validation_note explains), validation_quote (asserted on a cited line), round5 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}); round 6: round6 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}); validation_exempts maps a check to its whole failure message; round 7: round7 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}); round 8: n1v4_chain (the chain that mapped the row, or 'carried' for a v0.3 row carried unchanged in key), v0_3_row (the v0.3 row a chain's row restates, span#seq in results/raw/2026-10-09_note-N1-note-rows.json@ef5c446), n1v4_round2 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}: a C1/C2 row's change between the chain's round 1 and round 2), round8 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}: a carried row's change, or an integration edit); S11 is F1a (note_line: the text-node index, as for S9/S10); round 9: n1v5_chain (the chain that mapped the row, or 'carried' for a v0.4 row carried unchanged in key), v0_4_row (the v0.4 row a chain's row restates, span#seq in results/raw/2026-10-09_note-N1-v0_4-note-rows.json@fd2b136), round9 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}: a chain's change against that v0.4 row, or an integration edit; a previous of null: the field was absent), n1v5_round2 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}: a D8 row's change between the chain's round 1 and round 2), scope_corrected_in_note ({locator, quote, note_quote}: the PI's ruling 6 of 2026-10-10, on a branch-TS row; for an SVG row the note_quote may run from the row's node through the next nodes, newline-joined as note_text joins them), discharged ({ruling, note_quote}: ruling 7, on a branch-NT row), admitted_citation ({ruling, cited_source, note_quote}: ruling 8, on a not-found note row); round 10: n1v6_chain (the chain that mapped the row, G1-G3, or 'carried' for a v0.5 row carried unchanged in key), v0_5_row (the v0.5 row a chain's row restates, span#seq in results/raw/2026-10-10_note-N1-v0_5-note-rows.json@fa1b41e), round10 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}: a chain's change against that v0.5 row, or an integration edit; a previous of null: the field was absent; S1#428: G1's changes against v0.5's S1#378, then the integration's re-key at fix round 1, the previous seq, v0_5_row and comment recorded as changed entries (the comment entry, previous G1's comment, also takes fix round 2's comment edit, folded at fix round 3), then fix round 2's dropping of its v0.5 lineage field n1v5_chain, the previous value recorded; on a chain's record, the integration's entries follow the chain's own, one per field it changes: S1#428's four, and S5#106's comment, fix round 3), n1v6_round2 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}: a G3 row's change between the chain's round 1 and round 2), admitted_citation's 'reach' (the PI's ruling 11 of 2026-10-12, on an occurrence of an admitted citation at a (line, unit) ruling 8 does not name; S7#91); round 11: n1v8_chain (the chain that mapped the row: K1-K12), v0_6_row (the v0.6 row the row restates, span#seq in results/raw/2026-10-12_note-N1-v0_6-note-rows.json@c18854f, where the same unit and claim recur), round11 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}: every field that differs from that v0.6 row, previous the v0.6 value, null if absent; then each later edit of the round, the integration's and Code's, previous the value it replaced, null if absent, a withdrawal's previous carrying a marker in place of the withdrawn clause); n1v8_round2 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}: a row's change between its chain's round 1, the mapper's, and round 2, the check; previous the round-1 value, null if absent)
schema.status_rule: statuses are carried from the item raw (or the provisional ledger row) exactly, and the validator checks each against what the item raw gives (ledger 10a); a wording, scope or precision problem in the note's sentence is recorded in 'correction', never as a status (round 5)
